title: Lyon §4.3 Eq.(4) layout constraints (separatrix-deviation guarantee)
description:
Lyon §4.3: For every pair of intersecting traces t_i and t_j forming a triangle with angles larger than α (i.e. |α_ij| > α), enforce the additional separation of offending singularities in orthogonal direction:

    Σ q_a ≥ 1   for arcs a in S_ji,   when |α_ij| > α (Eq. 4)

This is THE quality-control mechanism. Without it, the layout has no guaranteed angular bound. Our layout currently reports dmean/dmax that don't match the paper because we don't enforce Eq.(4); the layout's separatrices can deviate arbitrarily.

Implementation: in MotorcycleGraph, track which intersection nodes have |α_ij| > α (we already compute α_ij for the stopping rule). For each such node n_ij, in Quantization.solve, add an Eq.(4) constraint: sum of q over arcs in S_ji ≥ 1.
definition-of-done: Rocker-arm at α=15°: dmean and dmax actually match the paper (3.7°, 14.7° within ±2°). Layout visually shows clean ≤α separatrix angles. Hand-30k similar.
testing-plan: Toy 4-singularity fixture with one bad-angle pair → assert Eq.(4) constraint forces a 1-arc separation. Rocker-arm: assert dmax ≤ α + 2°.
